About FitCalcHub

FitCalcHub was built to make everyday health and fitness numbers easy to calculate and easy to understand.

Our Approach

We keep things simple: free calculators built on widely recognized formulas, plain-English explanations underneath each one, and no accounts or paywalls in the way. Whether you're curious about your daily calorie needs, your BMI, your body fat percentage, or the macros in your next meal, FitCalcHub aims to give you a clear estimate in seconds.

What We're Not

FitCalcHub is an educational tool, not a medical service. Our calculators provide estimates based on established formulas — they don't replace advice from a doctor, dietitian, or other qualified healthcare professional. See our Medical Disclaimer for more detail.

Get in Touch

Have a question or suggestion? Visit our Contact page — we'd like to hear from you.
